digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment handling
propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling to 32767, matching the default jira.text.field.character.limit but ignoring when an administrator raises or removes this configurable limit

comments longer than the hardcoded 32767 but shorter than an instance's raised ceiling are silently truncated, causing data loss invisible to comment authors though a truncation warning is logged to operators

sanitize_comment and fit_comment both depend on the description-fitter fit_outbound function, creating a coupling hazard where future description-fitting changes could incorrectly retarget comment truncation

the endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties that exposes jira.text.field.character.limit requires admin permission and is unreadable by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, making runtime discovery of the instance limit infeasible

configurability of the DC comment ceiling was added as ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with default 32767, coercer range 0–2147483647, and separate _truncate_dc_comment_body function to decouple comments from description fitting
the fix preserves byte-identity with stock-instance behavior at the default ceiling and passes red-first unit tests proving raised and lowered ceilings are honored while zero means unlimited
